filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all topics. For 'Applying IEEE and APA Citation Styles', direct comparisons were rare, so practical tool-based tutorials covering both were chosen. For 'Finding and Evaluating Credible IT Sources', no IT-specific videos were found, so the best general academic search guides were selected. All other topics had strong, directly relevant candidates.
